_about: epic-dod.mjs config. `aliases` maps how sprint docs name a repo (`frontend #83`) to owner/repo. `exemptions` excuse ONE derived item on ONE epic closed before a convention existed, with the reason; an exemption on an item that now passes is STALE and fails the check. `bareRefsRepo` is null here on purpose: this is a multi-repo project, so a bare #N in a sprint doc could be any of three repos and is treated as unverifiable rather than guessed.
